$Comment: The sound a player hears when a hand-harvested pumpkin comes with Spices during Harvest Feast. The
file name is the moment id, and it is the Cue the spice row
(BonusRows/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Spice_Find.json) puts on its roll; a cue plays only when the
roll beside it handed something over.
It shows no line of its own: the Spices land like anything the player picks up, and the game's own
pickup notice already names them. Sound is any SoundEvent id, played where the player stands.
